title: Scrum delivery
description: Sprint planning, inspection and follow-through for teams that use Scrum.

rules.instruction: Before Sprint work is selected, ask the Scrum Team for the Sprint Goal and the Developers for their capacity, and record both in the Sprint Backlog.
rules.verification: Open the Sprint Backlog and check that it states the Sprint Goal and capacity, and that each selected item supports the goal or has a recorded reason.

rules.instruction: Record each dependency of the selected Sprint work in the Sprint Backlog with an owner, and update it as the Developers learn.
rules.verification: Check that every open dependency in the Sprint Backlog names an owner.

rules.instruction: Apply the team's Definition of Done to the Increment. At the Sprint Review, gather stakeholder feedback and use it to revisit the Product Backlog.
rules.verification: Trace completed items to evidence for the Definition of Done and check that Review feedback has a recorded backlog decision.

rules.instruction: Ask the Scrum Team which improvement from the Sprint Retrospective it will act on, and record it with an owner and what to observe in the next Sprint.
rules.verification: At the next Retrospective, check that the record gives the observed effect before the team decides whether to keep the change.
